evidence: Labeled Tests and touches only src/test/sock_tests.cpp, adding cross-platform unit test coverage for the Sock wrapper.
rationale: Comprehensive unit test coverage for `Sock` and platform socket readiness invariants catches realistic regressions following CVE-2026-117350. The PR exercises multi-socket event attribution, timeout bounds, and option inheritance on accepted sockets (which protects Linux users from remote forever-stalls). In test infrastructure, coverage of high-risk socket paths that catches realistic regressions ranks high.
